attempts96Cores.details: The relay closed one session after step 200. The original client log did not include the rejection reason.

scope.server: Same Space server, isolated Docker network with production WebSocket relay and 96 synthetic pilots in 48 paired flight areas.
scope.comparison: Same prebuilt engine and benchmark, aircraft, 500 simulation steps, worker groups and relay. The benchmark CPU affinity and quota were expanded from 64 to 96 physical cores. After a rejected WebSocket update, the isolated relay was instrumented to log validation failures without changing validation or the benchmark bundle.
scope.network: Average throughput from the local relay perspective, on an isolated single-host Docker network, including protocol overhead. Does not measure bandwidth or latency over a public internet connection.
scope.timing: 500 fixed steps, 25 simulated seconds, target 20 Hz. Step time covers replica sampling, process IPC, all-worker barrier and enqueue of outgoing frames. lateDeadlines also counts accumulated scheduling lateness. pose-network rates were measured over the same simulation window.
scope.cpu: Simulation CPU is the average cgroup CPU time divided by wall time, reported as occupied core equivalents. Percentages use the assigned 64 or 96 physical cores as denominator. Relay CPU is tracked separately.
scope.rapier: Current production Rapier loader with pin validation. Counts record selected native and compatibility solver substeps. The collision-enabled propeller is a separate body, which makes the aircraft ineligible for the resident Rapier path.
